#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Project Zomboid server — generated by provision().
# Settings: <ROOT>/installs/zomboid/gamedash-servers/test/Server/gamedash.ini
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
# the join and admin-console passwords, from GameDash (see common.password_sync)
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/zomboid/gamedash-servers/test/Server/gamedash.ini" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
t = open(p, encoding="utf-8", newline="").read()     # keep its line endings
bom = "\ufeff" if t.startswith("\ufeff") else ""
t = t[len(bom):]
for key, val in (
    ('Password', join),
    ('RCONPassword', admin),
):
    line = key + '=' + val
    pattern = r'(?m)^' + re.escape(key + '=') + r'[^\r\n]*'
    if re.search(pattern, t):
        t = re.sub(pattern, lambda m: line, t)
    else:
        t += line + '\n'
open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="").write(bom + t)
SYNC
cd "<ROOT>/installs/zomboid" || exit 1
exec ./start-server.sh -cachedir="<ROOT>/installs/zomboid/gamedash-servers/test" -servername gamedash -adminpassword "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD"
files.installs/zomboid/gamedash-test-stop.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed graceful stop: ask the server (over its admin console) to save and quit.
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
"<PYTHON>" - 27060 "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'STOP'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '<APP>')
import monitor
monitor.source_rcon(int(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], 'save', timeout=8)
STOP
i=0
while [ $i -lt 0 ] && pgrep -f -- '-cachedir=<ROOT>/installs/zomboid/gamedash-servers/test' >/dev/null; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
exit 0
